policy: 保留全部原测试、DoD 与九类适用性映射；本文件只补充审核修复断言，不用定向测试替代完整必需检查。实际结果以 verification.json 和原日志归档为准。

workerCases.reviewPoint: 授权与撤权竞争，包括 workspace 前置锁
names: serializes %s revocation before the send checkpoint and makes zero adapter calls
holds authorization through checkpoint commit and orders a later revocation after sending
workerCases.assertions: 停用、离队、重新指派、grant、delegation、Approval、Team 删除七类双事务竞争，观察真实 PostgreSQL 锁等待；撤权先提交时零 adapter 调用，反向顺序持锁至 checkpoint 提交。

workerCases.reviewPoint: 持久兼容通知 kind，排队后静音
names: persists the compatible approval kind for %s and rechecks a newly muted kind at send time
workerCases.assertions: approval.requested 与 partial quorum 的 approval.decision.recorded 都持久为 approval.requested；入队后设置 mutedKinds，发送时抑制且零 adapter 调用。

workerCases.reviewPoint: 逐条领取与 claim 丢失隔离
names: processes a full slow adapter batch without preclaiming waiting attempts and still schedules Loops
isolates a lost %s claim and continues deliveries and Loop work
workerCases.assertions: 完整 25 条批次，第一条 adapter 挂起时其余 24 条未 claim、重试计数为零；全批各领取一次。prepare/ack 丢失分别隔离，其他投递和真实 Loop 工作继续。

migrationAssertions: 新增两条迁移分别从前一阶段升级、after_sql 故障回滚、重复执行与空库 inventory 比较；保留 uncertain、attempt、fence、逻辑 attempt 及 legacy 通知语义。
completeSuites: 指定 worker 从审核基点的 36 项扩展为 49 项，迁移基线从 20 项扩展为 22 项；目标 API 原 9 项、A1 原 14 项和原有 Web Push/webhook/Automation/Loop 路径均进入最终完整集成检查。
outOfScope: 真实外发、真实发布、未来卡片审批和身份桥接；原可选 soak、runner、retention barrier、灾备 skip 不计通过。
